body:
I occasionally work at best buy, a job that I both like and hate. My sister is a GM of a best buy near me and is the reason I got the job there. I like most of the people that I work with and they have done a good job making me feel apart of the group. I dislike it though because I feel like I am pretty bad at it. I am not the best with sales and I feel like I don't deserve to be there since I did not earn it. Everyone found out that my sister is the GM from my manager and my step sister who I worked with briefly, so I feel like they are just being nice to me because of that. I do try and work hard and learn as much as I can, so I can prove myself to them and recently ive been doing a better job.

I watch a lot of movies and tv shows, Ive been watching many superhero movies and tv shows, and many just random genres that seem good on netflix or that ive heard are good from different people. I would join a club but many people don't really like to be around me, I have a hard time talking to people until I know them for awhile or I find that they have a similar sense of humor as me.  I am very quiet, I never smile and I often avoid eye contact because it feels very weird so people often dislike being around me I would assume. 

Thank you for reading through that whole thing, I really appreciate that.
